source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The first migration switched loading.png and its 2x source sets to a Gecko loading.svg. The follow-up introduced Thunderbird-owned spinning.svg and not-spinning.svg, registered them in jar packaging and changed consumers. A shared-module test helper was missed and fixed separately. Check the package registration, each active and idle asset, and the test’s expected URL together. Lower-case dash-separated SVG filenames describe this local asset family. ESR uplift of the large asset change was declined as an enhancement; dependent ESR work was told to use the existing Gecko spinner. No packaging or visual check was run.
title: Own shared loading assets and keep packaging and consumers aligned
